verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a generic marketing claim that you can "search and filter your application logs alongside your errors" (glitchtip-docs-8), plus the MCP server's ability to browse issues and inspect event data (glitchtip-docs-10). Releases and environments exist as concepts via CLI release and deploy commands, but nothing shows events being filtered by them. missing for 10: documented query syntax, filtering by tag, release, environment or custom properties, cross-project search, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of search capability.
